task_description: Recursive and iterative implementations for computing 2 raised to the power of n. The Power function defines 2^n recursively, while the ComputePower method achieves the same functionality through loop invocations of CalcPower, where CalcPower performs numerical doubling via multiplication. The program includes loop invariant proofs to ensure the correctness of iterative computation.
